transcript.text: Welcome to this guide on the Kalphite Queen in RuneScape Dragonwilds.
The Kalphite Queen is a Vault Boss encounter that has 2 major phases.
One where she is on the ground and one where she is flying.
When attempting this encounter, make sure to have at least access to 2 styles with you.
If you are going with melee, enchanting your weapon counts as magic.
If you are going with ranged, using enhanced arrows counts as magic as well.
So only if you are going with Magic is there a hard requirement to bring another style.
Let's get to the mechanics. In her first form, the Kalphite
Queen starts neutral, being able to take damage from any combat style.
As you deal more damage, she will turn into a colour depending on
the style you attacked her with, gaining immunity to that style. Red means she is immune to melee attacks.
Green means she is immune to ranged attacks. Blue means she is immune to magic attacks.
Whilst she is immune to a certain type, simply attack her with other styles.
For her own attacks, all attacks can be dodged either by moving away from her or dodge rolling.
Throughout the fight, also keep in mind that smaller kalphite can spawn,
killing them is adviced as they can make the fight pretty chaotic.
If she stands on her hind legs and her fangs turn yellow, she will bite at you shortly after.
When her front legs turn yellow, it means that she will follow it up with a series of jabs at you.
When she moves away from you, prepare for an incoming stampede from her by rolling to the side.
If she tilts one leg up, she is preparing a tremor-like attack
that deals damage immediately around her. As she raises her abdomen, she will start
launching poison from it, creating poisonous puddles all over the arena.
The landing areas are indicated by green circles. Avoid standing inside of them.
Once she reaches 0 life, she will shed her skin and transform into a flying version.
Melee is possible here, but Ranged and Magic are far easier as she will spend majority of the time in the air.
During this phase, she still can gain immunities to various styles,
so keep that in mind as you watch her colors, or the icon below her health bar.
For the flying version as well, if the claw turns yellow, she's preparing a
swooping slash attack, flying towards you. If her abdomen gets raised, she is about to launch
a poisonous barage, just like her previous form. When you see the Dragonwilds logo on the screen,
that means she's preparing to shoot a homing lightning ball at you.
Dodge it only at the very last moment, as dodging too early causes it to redirect at you afterall.
When you finally defeat her, you can go to the area after her and claim
your loot, being a vault core on the right. If you killed the Queen in the bottom right of
the map, there also is a hidden chest on the left side that contains the vestige for the Kerris,
a weapon that deals bonus damage to Kalphite monsters. I hope this guide was useful If it was, please subscribe
maybe even leave a like and see you next time bye
